say:2:1910522002:1.text: We came back together, didn't we?! She was holding my hand just now!
say:2:1910522002:1.source_cn: 我们一起回来的，对不对？她刚才还握着我的手！

say:3:1910522003:1.text: Morin, where are you?! Say something!

choice_prompt:4:1910522003.text: Morin, where are you?! Say something!

say:5:1910522005:1.text: She's still here, isn't she? She's right here with us. We just can't see her. This warm water, this light... I know she's here!
say:5:1910522005:1.source_cn: 她还在的，对吧？她就在我们身边，只是我们看不到她，这些...

say:6:1910522006:1.text: Morin! Oh, why did I always want to run away from home? You are all my home! This is where I should've been!
say:6:1910522006:1.source_cn: 姐姐！为什么我之前总想着往外跑呢？明明有你们在的地方才...

say:7:1910522007:1.text: Don't cry, my little jelly. She's still here... She's never going to leave us...
say:7:1910522007:1.source_cn: 别哭，我的小浪花。她在呢，她在呢，她不会离开我们的……

say:8:1910522008:1.text: Damn it! We were so close! I should've moved faster!
say:8:1910522008:1.source_cn: 该死，就差一点！咱应该行动再快一点！

say:10:1910522010:1.text: Come here, <style="stress"><player_name></style> and you too, fluffy child. You two need a hug as well. I saw that each of you tried very hard to save our little Shay.
say:10:1910522010:1.male: Come here, <style="stress"><player_name></style> and you too, fluffy child. You two need a hug as well. I saw that each of you tried very hard to save our little Shay.
say:10:1910522010:1.female: Come here, <style="stress"><player_name></style> and you too, fluffy child. You two need a hug as well. I saw that each of you tried very hard to save our little Shay.

say:11:1910522011:1.text: Shhh... Don't blame yourselves. You don't have to say anything right now. The seawater will carry all the sorrow away.
say:11:1910522011:1.source_cn: 嘘，嘘……不用自责，不要难过。现在什么都不用说。海水会...

say:12:1910522012:1.text: The moon strokes her silver comb over the deep, the wind combs waves to ribbons in their sweep. A cry on a distant shore you used to be. The sea set you in our coral hands to keep.
say:12:1910522012:1.source_cn: 月亮在海上磨着她的银梳，风把波浪梳成缕带。你曾是某个遥...

say:13:1910522013:1.text: Sleep now, child the waves took in. When the tide grows soft and thin, you will hear all those who went away, on the far side of the current's bend, softly speaking out your name. Hush now... Hush...
say:13:1910522013:1.source_cn: 睡吧，被浪收养的孩子；当潮声变轻，你会听见所有离开的人...

narration:15:1910522014:1.text: Menoa gathers you all in her arms, humming softly as she gently pats your backs.
narration:15:1910522014:1.male: Menoa gathers you all in her arms, humming softly as she gently pats your backs.
narration:15:1910522014:1.female: Menoa gathers you all in her arms, humming softly as she gently pats your backs.

narration:16:1910522015:1.text: 不甘与悔恨慢慢沉淀，你将它们尽数吞咽，这次失败不会击垮你

narration:17:1910522016:1.text: 你思考着……直到那抹潮光再次出现

choice_prompt:18:1910522016.text: 你思考着……直到那抹潮光再次出现
choice_prompt:18:1910522016.source_cn: 你思考着……直到那抹潮光再次出现

say:19:1910522017:4.text: That thing is unstoppable. Get on the Waterstrider. I'll take you somewhere farther away!
say:19:1910522017:4.source_cn: 那东西甚至没法挡住，上水行器，我载你们去更远的地方！

choice_prompt:20:1910522017.text: That thing is unstoppable. Get on the Waterstrider. I'll take you somewhere farther away!
choice_prompt:20:1910522017.source_cn: 那东西甚至没法挡住，上水行器，我载你们去更远的地方！

say:22:1910522020:1.text: If we rise to the surface, we can escape the glowing tide. Grandma, have the Tidewarden carry everyone up!
say:22:1910522020:1.source_cn: 上浮到海面，就能避开海底涌来的光。阿嬷，让波涛长者载大...

say:23:1910522021:1.text: We cannot speak with the Tidewarden. It has never listened to our songs.
say:23:1910522021:1.source_cn: 毛绒孩子，我们无法与波涛长者对话，它也从不聆听我们的歌声。

say:24:1910522022:1.text: But it's our best shot. I have to try. You guys go ahead.
say:24:1910522022:1.source_cn: 这是最好的办法！咱去试，你们走。

say:27:1910522025:1.text: I cannot let two children face everything all on their own. We're family after all. My little jelly, we'll come back safe. I swear it.
say:27:1910522025:1.source_cn: 阿嬷不能让两个小娃儿自己面对一切，我们都是家人。我的小...

say:29:1910522027:1.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style> and fluffy child, I will go gather the people of the other clans, and together, we'll present our wishes to the Tidewarden. Perhaps it will hear us.
say:29:1910522027:1.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style> and fluffy child, I will go gather the people of the other clans, and together, we'll present our wishes to the Tidewarden. Perhaps it will hear us.
say:29:1910522027:1.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style> and fluffy child, I will go gather the people of the other clans, and together, we'll present our wishes to the Tidewarden. Perhaps it will hear us.

say:30:1910522028:1.text: May the ocean currents bless us...

choice:20:0:1.text: Is there really no way to stop it?
choice:20:0:1.male: Is there really no way to stop it?
choice:20:0:1.female: Is there really no way to stop it?

choice:20:1:2.text: We need a solution that puts an end to this.
choice:20:1:2.source_cn: 需要一劳永逸的解决方法
choice:20:1:2.male: We need a solution that puts an end to this.
choice:20:1:2.female: We need a solution that puts an end to this.

choice:20:2:3.text: Find a way to make Coralia rise to the surface!
choice:20:2:3.male: Find a way to make Coralia rise to the surface!
choice:20:2:3.female: Find a way to make Coralia rise to the surface!

choice:18:0:1.text: The light hasn't gone away. We need to act now!
choice:18:0:1.source_cn: 光芒没有消失，我们需要行动！
choice:18:0:1.male: The light hasn't gone away. We need to act now!
choice:18:0:1.female: The light hasn't gone away. We need to act now!

choice:18:2:3.text: We can't let anyone else be swallowed up.
choice:18:2:3.male: We can't let anyone else be swallowed up.
choice:18:2:3.female: We can't let anyone else be swallowed up.

choice:4:0:1.text: I'm sorry. We were too late...
choice:4:0:1.male: I'm sorry. We were too late...
choice:4:0:1.female: I'm sorry. We were too late...

say:33:1910522004:1.text: It is my fault! I didn't try hard enough!
say:33:1910522004:1.source_cn: 不，是我的错，是我还不够尽力！

choice:4:2:3.text: You did your best... It's not your fault...
choice:4:2:3.source_cn: 你们尽力了，不是任何人的错
choice:4:2:3.male: You did your best... It's not your fault...
choice:4:2:3.female: You did your best... It's not your fault...
